Officer's narrative
Officers responded to a report of a two-vehicle collision at a signalized intersection in Houston, Texas. Driver 1 stated
that the vehicle was struck on the driver's side by Driver 2, who enteerd the intersection against the signal. Driver 2
acknowledged the approach and did not dispute how the collision occurred. Photographs taken at the scene and
statements from two independent witnesses are consistent with that account, and both witnesses described the
ipmact as sudden and forceful. Driver 1 is the named insured on the policy for the vehicle involved. A passenger,
identified only as Passenger, was seated in the front right position and was confirmed present by officers and both
witnesses. Passenger reported neck and back strain at the scene and was transported for evaluation. It is not yet
clear whether these injuries resulted from this collision, as no medical findings had been made at the time of this
report. Officers noted a few older scratches on the rear quarter panel that may predate this crash, and it is not clear
whether all of the visible damage resulted from this impact. Further assessment is recommended.

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- occupants_listed: How many people does the police report list in the insured vehicle (Vehicle 1)? The rating is a whole number. Allowed: a whole number.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
